messages:
Maria: Quick sync — we need to lock scope + launch criteria for Dashboards, Tracing Hooks, Cost breakdown, and Error analytics for Console Q3. Customers surfaced three concrete asks: per-route cost, adaptive trace sampling for hot routes, and error-regression alerts tied to eval sets. Proposing a trimmed MVP: 1) route-level cost table with top-10 ops, 2) tracing hooks exposing p95 latency + sampling config, 3) basic error anomaly alerts with top examples. Thoughts?

AJ: I like the MVP. One question: when we say cost, do we expose token estimates only or show infra $cost too? Customers will ask for dollars.

Kevin: Token + $ is necessary. We can show tokens, estimated $/route/day, and an "effective cost per token" by model variant. That requires billing + GPU-hour attribution ingestion.

Olivia: For tracing hooks: 1% sampling for hot routes will likely miss regressions. Suggest adaptive sampling: baseline 5% + spike-triggered burst to 20% for N minutes when latency deviates. We can reuse existing trace pipeline but need to surface controls in UI.

Sam: From product/UX: customers want per-route breakdown in console, collapsible rows, and CSV export. Also add an API endpoint so infra teams can pull raw numbers programmatically.

Meera: Rollout idea: alpha to internal orgs, canary to 5% production orgs. Acceptance gates: cost estimates within 20% vs actual bill, and alert false-positive rate <5% on historical evals.

Maria: Proposed acceptance criteria for MVP: (a) Dashboard shows route, model, tokens, estimated $/day, and delta vs prior period. (b) Tracing hooks expose sampling config + live tail for selected route. (c) Error alerts integrate with eval-set baseline and surface top N failing examples. Timeline: alpha in 3 sprints, canary 2 sprints after.

AJ: Dependencies list: billing tags on requests, model-level cost metadata, and storage/retention for increased traces. I'll own billing-tags RFC.

Kevin: Cost calc notes — we need a mapping: model_variant -> cost_per_token + infra_amortization. Also account for quantized variants. I'll prototype math; will need a small nightly job to compute rolling "effective cost".

Olivia: Implementation detail for adaptive sampling: we can implement a simple rule in tracer-agent: if route_p95 > baseline*1.2 then temporarily raise sampling_rate. We'll also provide a UI toggle.

Sam: UX / wireframe ask: show a compact timeseries for cost and p95 side-by-side, with a small config flyout for sampling. CSV columns: date, org, route, model, tokens, est_dollars, p95_ms, errors.

Meera: Private deployment note: for Private/Dedicated customers we need to support local billing tags + KMS audit. That will push private rollout later.

AJ: Quick RFC snippet for SDK header (we need this in docs and SDKs):
```http
POST /v1/generate
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <token>
  X-Redwood-Billing: route=payments;model=gpt-4r;variant=8bit
```
This header will be used to attribute token counts.

Kevin: Also callout: caching changes cost attribution. If KV cache served X% of tokens, we need to subtract cached tokens from billable estimate.

Olivia: For alerting, target p95 for performance alerts. p99 is too noisy with small sample sizes. Keep p95 for now; we'll capture p99 in traces view.

Sam: Launch phasing: Hosted API only for MVP (simpler), Dedicated + Private next quarter. UI should clearly mark which datapoints are "hosted-only" if not available in private.

Meera: Risk log: (1) cost drift from caching and batching, (2) storage cost from increased trace retention, (3) alert noise. Mitigations: testing on historical traces, cap retention defaults, and eval-driven alert tuning.

Maria: Decision summary: proceed with trimmed MVP: per-route token + est $; tracing hooks p95 + adaptive sampling; basic error regression alerts with top examples. Action owners: AJ -> billing tags, Kevin -> cost math + job, Olivia -> tracing impl, Sam -> UI & CSV, Meera -> rollout & gates. Please confirm by EOD with a short ack. :thumbsup:

AJ: :thumbsup: I'll open the billing-tags RFC and small SDK PR by EOD.

Kevin: On it — will attach prototype spreadsheet for cost math.

Olivia: Working on sampling plan + agent change, will post perf impact numbers.

Sam: I'll share wireframes tomorrow morning and start API stub.

Meera: Drafting canary checklist now, will ping infra for retention budget.

deploy-bot: Canary checklist created: https://internal.redwood/deploy/checklists/obs-mvp-canary

Maria: Thanks team — I'll consolidate the PRD and update roadmap JIRA. Will follow up with timelines.
